operations.description: This API is used to create an application.

Starts a single stream recording job. The naming rule of single-stream recording triggered by the API is as follows: {jobtype}\_{jobid}\_{roomid}\_{userid} If the value of jobtype is **s**, the job is a single stream recording job.

Creates and starts a mixed stream recording job. Both audio-only recording and audio & video recording are supported. - Audio-only recording If encode_template is set to audio_only, the three parties with the loudest voices are dynamically selected during audio stream mixing. Leave layout_template, layout_panes, and other video-related parameters empty. - Audio & video recording (including desktop sharing) If encode_template is not audio_only, layout_template and layout_panes must not be left empty. The three parties with the loudest voices are dynamically selected during audio stream mixing. The name of the stream mixing recording triggered by the API is in the format of {jobtype}\_{jobid}\_{roomid}, in which the value of jobtype is **m**, indicating that the stream mixing recording is triggered.

Creates or updates a recording rule. - If the current application does not have a recording rule in the requested location, a new recording rule will be created. - If the current application has a recording rule in the requested location, the recording rule will be replaced with the new one.
This API is used to delete an application.
This API is used to delete a recording rule. Recording rules that are being used cannot be deleted.
This API is used to list applications.
Querying the Object List in an OBS Bucket
Querying the OBS Bucket List
This API is used to list recording rules.
Querying call exception details of a specified app.Data within 5 days can be queried.
Queries the distribution of call exception details of a specified app in a specified period. The maximum query time span is one day.
Queries call exception details of a specified application. The maximum query time span is one day.

This API is used to query the call quality indicators of a user. Data of the last five days can be queried. The value of mid cannot be null. When real-time data is queried, the interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed 24 hours. Cross-day query is supported for query data of a single user.
Querying call exception details of a specified app.Data within 5 days can be queried.
This API is used to query experience data of quality indicators in the last 31 days. You cannot obtain the experience data of the current day. The maximum query time span is 31 days.
This API is used to query scale data of indicators of each day in the last 31 days. You cannot obtain the number of rooms and users of the current day. The maximum query time span is 31 days.
This API is used to query usage data of various services in a past period.
Obtains the statistics on real-time network indicators of every minute in a specified period. The maximum query time span is one day.
Queries the statistics on real-time quality-related indicators of every minute in a specified period. The maximum query time span is one day.
Queries the statistics on scale-related indicators of every minute in a specified period. The maximum query time span is one day.
This API is used to query the statistics on scale-related indicators in a specified dimension. Scale-related data can be ranked based on the number of online users in a specified dimension.
Lists rooms created in a specified period. The maximum query time span is 90 days.
Lists users who joined a room within a specified period. The maximum query time span is 90 days.
Dismisses a room and removes all users from the room.
Forces a user to leave a room.
This API is used to query details about an application.
This API is used to query the automatic recording configuration.
This API is used to query a single stream recording job. Information in the OBS bucket of a tenant cannot be queried.
This API is used to query a mixed stream recording job.
This API is used to query the recording event callback configuration.
This API is used to query a specified recording rule.
This API is used to enable an application.

Disables an application. After the application is disabled, new rooms cannot be added or joined, and rooms that have been joined can still be used. The stream mixing and recording functions are also unavailable.
This API is used to stop a single stream recording job.
This API is used to stop a delivered mixed stream recording job.
This API is used to update the automatic recording configuration. Tenants can enable or disable automatic single-stream recording on demands.
Modifies a single stream recording job. The job can be modified only in some scenarios.
This API is used to update the layout of a mixed stream recording job.
Authorizing and Canceling OBS Bucket Authorization

Configures a recording event callback. When a subscribed event occurs in a task, the callback address configured through this API is used to receive a notification. For details about the callback content, see [Value-added (Recording) Event Callback Notification Content](rtc_07_0021.xml).
This API is used to update a recording rule.
